announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: HUGO BOSS AG: STEPHAN STURM TO STEP DOWN AS CHAIRMAN AND MEMBER OF THE SUPERVISORY BOARD OF HUGO BOSS
announcements.insight: This marks the conclusion of a significant leadership transition in the European luxury apparel sector; while Sturm's departure is part of a planned succession rather than a crisis exit, it signals the end of an era for Hugo Boss's recent turnaround strategy and introduces uncertainty regarding the new chairman's strategic direction.
